channel.title: MotleyTech
channel.description: Variegated technical notes and interactive demos

item.title: Building molecules out of two rules
item.description: A 3D playground for building molecules, where the shapes are not looked up in a table but fall out of bond lengths and the fact that things attached to the same atom push each other away.

item.title: Four ways to keep a tree balanced
item.description: Interactive simulations of AVL trees, Red-Black trees, B-trees and treaps, narrating every rotation, recolour, split and merge.

item.title: The game behind TREE(3)
item.description: A playground for the tree game that defines TREE(n), with a checker that decides whether each tree you play is legal.

item.title: Visualizing solar eclipses
item.description: An interactive visualization of the Sun, Moon and Earth geometry that produces a solar eclipse.

item.title: Task management app
item.description: A lightweight, visual task board that runs entirely in the browser with no backend or account.

item.title: Balanced binary tree animated
item.description: An animated AVL tree that shows the rotations keeping insert, find and delete fast.

item.title: Minesweeper
item.description: The classic Minesweeper game rebuilt with React, plain CSS and a flood fill.

item.title: Todo list with React and LocalStorage
item.description: A todo list built with React that persists to localStorage and survives closing the tab.

item.title: Sudoku solver
item.description: A randomized JavaScript Sudoku solver, ported from an earlier Python version.

item.title: Orbit Camera for 3D scenes
item.description: Orbit controls that rotate and zoom around whatever object sits under the mouse pointer.

item.title: Magic Squares
item.description: How to construct magic squares of any order, where every row, column and diagonal share a sum.

item.title: Bezier curve playground
item.description: An interactive Bezier curve playground built on the curve support already in the browser.

item.title: Fun with circle chords
item.description: Periodic chords drawn inside a circle conjure up cardioids and other unexpected shapes.

item.title: Leo Szilard - The Man who changed the World
item.description: The physicist who patented the nuclear chain reaction and then spent his life trying to contain it.

item.title: Gravity Train
item.description: Gravity powered vacuum tubes through the Earth make every journey take the same 42 minutes.

item.title: Falling into the sun
item.description: If the Earth were stopped in its orbit, how long would it take to fall into the Sun?
